Title: Adapting Parent–Child Interaction Therapy to Foster Care: Outcomes From a Randomized Trial
Author: Mersky, Topitzes, Grant-Savela, Brondino, & McNeil
Comment: Table 1 reports least-squares ADJUSTED means with STANDARD ERRORS (not SDs); SEs recorded in the _se fields. Per-arm analysed Ns are not reported, so SD cannot be reconstructed from SE and no MD/effect size was computed. M_diff was deliberately left empty because these are covariate-adjusted marginal means from a mixed-model ANCOVA (rule 3 prohibition). The reported p = .111 / ES = .02 is the linear condition-by-time INTERACTION contrast for G1 vs G2 across all three time points, not a simple post-treatment mean difference.
